notes.title: Major changes in Codename Nemesis
notes.notes:
Hello friends,
I'm the developer of Codename Nemesis.
First and foremost, I offer you my deepest apologies for the delay in the game production, and the intensive lack of updates.

I've had multiple feedbacks since I had released the demo in Dec 2018. Since then I have been working around taking only the positives to bring out an even better experience of Codename Nemesis. But sadly, I could not deliver on time. There were multiple reasons which most of us did face in recent times. As a solo developer on the game, I did take an emotional, financial, and situational hit during the Pandemic and the times that followed. But that did not stop me nor people who believed in Codename Nemesis from leaving all those behind and keep moving forward. The progress was slow but ongoing.

And finally, I wanted to slowly unveil the complete makeover the game has taken visually, story and gameplay-wise. I have updated the dates on the store page and also added a few screenshots of the newly done changes. These will be replaced soon with newer ones once I get closer to the release date which will be publicly announced soon along with a new game trailer.

All this is done only so you could have a better experience with our debut title, Codename Nemesis and we don't want to leave any stones unturned.

And last but not the least, I have taken down the demo off the store page. The current gameplay, mechanics, graphics & storytelling have taken an intensive makeover for the good. I will be revealing them slowly and steadily on my social media pages and website and also the store page. You're definitely going to love every bit and piece of changes done.

A big thank you for playing the demo, loving Codename Nemesis, adding it to your Wishlist, and most importantly, waiting & not giving up on it even when I've left no breadcrumbs to follow. Do continue your support for the game. Also, follow us on our social media handles that are linked on our website which will have regular posts and updates henceforth.

Sorry and Thank You.
